content.body:
A health certificate is mandatory for every guest before Kawah Ijen crater entry, per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024. JVTO coordinates the clinic workflow for every guest.

A regulatory rule, coordinated by us

The screening is set by BBKSDA (the East Java conservation authority) under Surat Edaran SE.1658/KSA.9/2024 — it is not JVTO-imposed. JVTO integrates the workflow so every guest arrives at the crater gate with a valid certificate.

No valid QR code = no crater-zone access.

The four-step protocol

  1. A nurse visits your hotel the evening before the hike (Bondowoso / Banyuwangi area).
  2. Vitals recorded: SpO2, blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory history.
  3. QR surat sehat issued, signed by Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, SIP (STR QN00001073380217).
  4. BBKSDA scans the QR code at the crater gate before entry.

faqs.q: Is the health certificate really mandatory?
faqs.a: Yes — mandatory for every guest before crater entry, per BBKSDA SE.1658/KSA.9/2024. No valid QR code means no crater-zone access.
Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu, SIP — STR QN00001073380217, verifiable on the Kemenkes SATUSEHAT registry.

A full cancellation at least 48 hours before Day 1 converts your payment to 100% JVTO Lifetime Package Credit — never cash, non-expiring, locked to the same package, traveler count and price, and transferable to another person once. A full cancellation within 48 hours, or a no-show, is forfeited. Partial cancellations (some travelers drop while at least two paying travelers remain) are refunded in cash on the cancelled seats only: 100% at least 48 hours before Day 1, 50% within 48 hours, 0% once the tour has started. If a confirmed flight is cancelled by the airline with no alternative, a 50% flight Recovery Fee applies and the remainder converts to Lifetime Package Credit. Bookings are made only on the JVTO website; WhatsApp and email are support-only.

A 20% deposit confirms the booking (up to 100% if Day 1 is within 14 days), processed through JVTO's secure payment gateway, Xendit. Pay by card or QRIS (QRIS is convenient for ASEAN travellers); the card or QRIS balance is due no later than 5 days before Day 1, and Wise or bank transfer no later than 3 days before. The card/QRIS fee is shown at Xendit checkout before you confirm, and JVTO adds no surcharge on Wise or bank transfers. A cash IDR balance is possible at the JVTO office before Day 1 only if approved in writing and only if you have already converted to IDR yourself.
